options.misconception: Uses the classical kinetic-energy formula mv^2/2
Uses mass times light speed ignoring the actual velocity
Omits the velocity factor from gamma times mass times v

questions.explanation: Relativistic momentum is p = gamma times m times v = 1.497 times 1.00 × 10^-27 times 0.744c = 3.34 × 10^-19 kg m/s. The classical value m times v omits gamma and is too small; m times c ignores the particle's actual speed; gamma times m times c omits the velocity factor entirely.
questions.hint: Multiply the classical momentum by the Lorentz factor gamma.
